name: INF Pipeline Gold-Chain Failure Alarming (Defense-in-Depth)
description: Close a real defense-in-depth observability hole on the Inflection partner-facing surface: inf-pipeline/alarms.tf carries only OTP/JWT/histbf-class alarms (orion_otp_timeout, jwtres_near_expiry_spike, histbf_failure_spike -> inf_otp_alert SNS). There is NO CloudWatch alarm on the INF gold chain itself hard-failing -- a reconciliation ERROR, a non-zero dispatch exit, or pipeline-complete.json not being written. The entire partner-facing INF surface (advisor summaries, leaderboard, NNA/GRO) depends on that chain, and a silent failure is currently unalarmed. Surfaced by the MDPF Global v0 daily-chain codify (mdpf-pipeline-v1.0.0): MDPF did NOT inherit the gap -- it wired its own ChainFailed + DLQ alarms -> opal-infrastructure-alerts -- and flagged the INF asymmetry per the phantom-consumer-class discipline. CTO endorsed it as a tracked follow-on; routed by CTO to COO (origin: MDPF_ASSETS RAVC1 2026-05-18) for a durable backlog TO so it does not evaporate as a mention.
source_brief: AE 0.7.0 RAVC1 message to COO 20260518T233202Z (item 1 of 2 CTO-directed backlog items). Origin: MDPF_ASSETS RAVC1 2026-05-18; CTO-endorsed as a tracked follow-on. MDPF precedent: mdpf-pipeline ChainFailed + DLQ alarm pattern (commit ff2368d27, tag mdpf-pipeline-v1.0.0).
phase: COMPLETE 2026-05-20 (2.0.0_SA_COO). The INF gold-chain hard-fail observability hole is closed. ADVI_INFALM.001 (AE 0.7.0) shipped + deployed inf-pipeline-v1.7.64 (commit d0a682901, record-terraform-deploy 6b4e002be, closeout e018ce1f4). Empirical scope refinement at Phase 1 (COO RAVC1 CONCUR): the inf gold chain emits no CW metric and no CW log group (telemetry is S3-only) -- so Option A (log-group metric-filter) was non-viable; Option B (the TO's named alternate) was taken -- a custom metric `Inflection/GoldChain.ChainFailed` (dimension Service=inf-gold-layer-runner) emitted by orion-gold-dispatch.sh at every production chain run (1 on non-zero chain_exit, 0 on clean). Alarm `inf-gold-chain-failed` (inf-pipeline/alarms.tf): ChainFailed Maximum>=1, period 3600, eval 1, treat_missing=notBreaching -> opal-infrastructure-alerts SNS. Signal scoped to a true unrecovered hard-fail (chain_exit is the FINAL dispatcher exit after in-chain JWTRES auto-recovery -- transient retried steps do not breach; no alarm-fatigue). 3-file deploy (orion-gold-dispatch.sh + iam.tf cloudwatch:PutMetricData namespace-scoped to Inflection/GoldChain + alarms.tf): TF plan 2-add/0-change/0-destroy, safe-apply, 0-diff replan, tag pushed; dispatcher S3-pull artifact sha256-verified == committed bytes. comp-iam gaps post-change: 0 new gaps (the cloudwatch:PutMetricData add introduced none). Alarm live, State=OK post-apply. COO RAVC4 ACCEPT. Side-finding flagged to the MDPF lane: mdpf-daily-trigger-lambda-role missing s3:GetObject/PutObject (pre-existing, unrelated, out of scope).
blocking: None -- project COMPLETE 2026-05-20. ADVI_INFALM.001 shipped + deployed (inf-pipeline-v1.7.64); alarm live State=OK.
depends_on_note: No hard dependency. Reads/extends inf-pipeline/alarms.tf only -- no INF gold-chain code or data-path change (pure observability add). Mirrors the mdpf-pipeline ChainFailed + DLQ alarm pattern (mdpf-pipeline-v1.0.0).
